findings.summary: Stale aside copy changes consent consequences and falsely declares feature-wide unavailability.
findings.evidence: English asks to confirm adding this aside to the conversation; French says la remarque deviendra la conversation principale and Spanish says el apunte se convertirá en la conversación principal (the aside will become the main conversation). English unavailable is this aside is no longer available; both locales instead say asides are unavailable in this version.
findings.fix: Retranslate both keys against the frozen English: adding this aside, not replacing the main conversation; this individual aside unavailable, not the whole feature/version.
findings.origin: Pre-existing target strings, not introduced by current alias-only translation; explicitly in requested full-namespace first-audit scope.

findings.summary: Other stale desktop messages lose the specific condition or remedy.
findings.evidence: answer_epoch_mismatch substitutes generic conversation changed/reload for earlier session owner. aside_max_turns omits both 16 exchanges and start a new aside. aside_still_running reports running but omits wait before closing.
findings.fix: Align these three keys to the current owner-mismatch condition, 16-exchange/new-aside remedy, and wait-before-close instruction.

findings.summary: Kept-English Hub operation terminology is inconsistently translated.
findings.evidence: Glossary section 2 wave-2 and locale guides keep pull and merge as Latin Hub/git operations. Both alias messages replace Pull with native retrieve/download equivalents in every locale. Chinese/Russian/Urdu/Hindi additionally translate or transliterate merge in preview_required, no_llm_help, inherited_assets, and the alias messages. Literal strategy values and actual commands are preserved, so this is a glossary-follow-up rather than a broken invocation.
findings.fix: Retain literal pull and merge in Hub-operation prose, inflecting surrounding native text; keep descriptive consolidated-version wording where it does not name the operation.
